meta.about.title: About us | Standards and structured execution
about.title: About us
about.text: Emmeci Costruzioni srl is a renovation and interior finishing company. We work with a simple method: listen, plan in writing, execute with precision and deliver what we promised.
about.std.title: Our standards
about.std.1: One point of contact for the whole duration of the works
about.std.2: Quote and schedule in writing before we start
about.std.3: An orderly, protected site that is always open to inspection
about.std.4: Final inspection together with the client before handover
about.how.title: Structured execution
about.how.text: Every trade has an owner, a sequence and a check. That keeps timelines reliable and the result in line with what you approved.
